groups.o: o_proj (row-parallel, decode all-reduce / prefill reduce-scatter after it)
groups.gate_up: gate_proj + up_proj (FF1 + FF3, column-parallel; prefill packed copy uses the same dtype)

activations.decode_intermediates_note: decode matmul outputs kept on chip (qkv, gate_up, the MLP product, norm outputs) are BF16; the o_proj and down outputs that feed the decode all-reduce take ccl.decode_all_reduce (BFP8)

logits.softcap: 30 * tanh(x / 30) on device into the persistent BF16 logits buffer

sampling.note: on-device two-level top-32 per chip over the vocab-sharded BF16 logits; greedy = lowest-id argmax

selection.selected_from: re-selection in the vLLM stage (doc/datatype_sweep/README.md 'Stage-9 re-selection'): the previous selection gu4all_down4_13_46_o4in_lmh4 fails the recall set (11 / 14). b0_lmh4_lofi is selected by scripts/aggregate.py's rule: the fastest config that passes the token gate, the v5 screen, the full-context check and the recall set, where accepted configs with overlapping TF repetition ranges are tied and the tie goes to the fewest matmul math-fidelity passes (b0_lmh4_hifi2 is bit-identical and tied; same-session token-out LoFi 12.261-12.262 ms vs HiFi2 12.264-12.265 ms, logs/stage9/perf_token_out_*_ab*.json)
selection.token_gate: min(run_prefill_check, run_teacher_forcing) on bringup/references/gemma4_12b_it_aime24_chat.refpt: top-1 >= 0.90, top-5 >= 0.98, top-100 = 1.00
selection.screen: clean shared qualitative suite; tests/test_full_model.py user-split and non-aligned tests on natural text; HF-anchored split-placement check (long 8k reference, B = 8 / 16, every row on both placements top-5 >= 0.98, top-100 = 1.00, split-vs-unsplit PCC > 0.9); long 8k prefill check (top-5 >= 0.98, top-100 = 1.00); 7 full-context needle variants at 131K / 262K tokens: every pass key retrieved, no extra thought block; stage-9 addition: the plugin's chunked-prefill recall set (tests/tt/test_chunked_prefill.py prompts in chat format, thinking off: solo split, 3-budget split, 3 rounds x 4 shared-step documents, about 11K / 33K tokens): every passphrase recalled with no extra thought block
selection.ranking_metric: trace-verified teacher-forcing decode t/s/u (batch 1, 99 forced steps, median of 5)
selection.lm_head_program: DRAM-sharded, 3 readers per bank (BFP4 head; tt/model.py LM_HEAD_PROGRAM_BY_DTYPE)
selection.consumed_by: tt/precision.py PrecisionConfig.load(None) in Gemma4Model.__init__ (build_generator and every adapter built on them); Gemma4Model verifies the built model against it
